svg.title: StockResearchAgents component architecture
svg.desc: Inbound adapters call the StockResearchAgents application core. The public company-analytics.v1 profile composes an outer CompanyAnalyticsSubmissionV1 around an embedded CompanyResearchSubmissionV1 and ResearchDossierV1. Run-control.v1 coordinates durable state, while outbound adapters expose only completed projections.
